markup:
If your goal is to run a **1,500W electric space heater for as long as possible**, you want a portable power station with the largest battery capacity (Wh), not necessarily the highest wattage output.

The catch is that space heaters consume enormous amounts of electricity, so even a massive battery station may only last a few hours.

## How long can a power station run a space heater?

Assuming a 1,500W heater running continuously and roughly 90% inverter efficiency:

| Battery capacity | Estimated runtime |
|---|---|
| 2,000Wh | 1.2 hours |
| 4,000Wh | 2.4 hours |
| 6,000Wh | 3.6 hours |
| 10,000Wh | 6 hours |
| 15,000Wh | 9 hours |
| 20,000Wh | 12 hours |

The most interesting options are expandable power stations, because they can hold much more energy than conventional portable units.
